author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Thank you Front Line Gaming for sponsoring this episode.  Matts, terrain, gaming accessories you name it they got it.  Tickets are available for the Las Vegas Open, one of the largest 40k tournaments in the world on October 1st to 4th.  Also this year, Gundam Assemble, KOTC and more are running events.  It's sure to be a blast. 
https://www.lasvegasopen.net


We now know that Pedro Kantor is being sunsetted.  But perhaps, before he hangs his chainsword, he might have one more fight in him. 

Aiden and Steve are at it again.  This time the Crimson Fists have discovered some "traitors" and are determined to end them before the corruption spreads. 

The guard seek to prove their loyalty by killing the Emperors Angels. Let's see how that goes for them..


===============ARMY LIST=============

Steve's Crimson Fists. 

Detachment one - Gladius Task Force
Detachment two - Designation force
Disposition - Priority Assets


Aiden
Detachment one - Siege Regiment
Disposition - Reconnaissance
title: Pedro's Last Crusade. Crimson Fists vs Astra Militarum | Warhammer 40k in 40m
